0022600147.text: The Trail Blazers come into this game at 3-1, 2nd in the Northwest and half a game back, with a 2-0 road record and a 3-1 mark over their last ten, though they lost their most recent game. The Jazz are 1-4, 5th in the Northwest three games back and 12th in the West, and they have lost three straight. Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after the Trail Blazers won 4-0 in 2025-26, most recently 124-114 in Portland on March 13, 2026.
